secret_aes_key.content: CONFIRMED: Hardcoded AES-256 symmetric key in TelemetryCodec class: 'Vu1nB1az0r$ecretKey!2026@@@@@@@@' (32 bytes). Algorithm: AES-CBC (CipherMode=1), PKCS7 padding (PaddingMode=2). IV is randomly generated per encryption, prepended to ciphertext (IV + ciphertext), then Base64-encoded. Key is static const string, fully recoverable from decompiled client. Used for TelemetryCodec.Encode() and Decode() methods.

crypto_impl_telemetry_codec.content: AES-256-CBC crypto implementation in TelemetryCodec class. Key: hardcoded const string 'Vu1nB1az0r$ecretKey!2026@@@@@@@@' (32 bytes).
